column1: #. Options → Accounts: what these accounts are, and the services' rule against sharing

column2: A debrid service downloads a file host's link with your own paid account and gives DDM a direct link. Use only your own account: sharing an account or its links breaks the services' terms and can get it suspended. Downloads the browser already started stay as they are.
column3: Bidh seirbheis debrid a’ luchdachadh sìos ceangal aoigheachd faidhle leis a’ chunntas pàighte agad fhèin agus a’ toirt ceangal dìreach do DDM. Na cleachd ach do chunntas fhèin: bidh roinneadh cunntais no a cheanglaichean a’ briseadh cumhachan nan seirbheisean agus faodaidh e a bhith air a chur dheth. Bidh luchdachadh sìos a thòisich am brabhsair mar-thà a’ fuireach mar a tha iad.
